payload.objective: Build a passive, evidence-bound Claim Harvester that finds legitimately claimable value without customer sales or person-to-person communication.
payload.scope: Source architecture, deterministic eligibility/value gates, runtime-only wallet aliases, tests, provenance/effect boundaries, and integration seams for Discovery, Ingest, Roots, Lou-Pole, Voss/Cricket, WIP, Project Runner, Pre-Active, and Vera Works. No claim submission, signature, account creation, terms acceptance, identity/tax submission, spend, customer communication, or private-key handling is authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Unclaimed is never treated as ownerless.
Only explicit ENTITLED or OPEN_CLAIM candidates from authoritative evidence can advance beyond research.
Wallet-specific candidates require exact runtime beneficiary matching without committing full wallet addresses.
Identity/signature/account/terms boundaries stop at explicit Patrick holds.
Passing candidates stop at exact external-effect authorization rather than auto-claiming.
Deterministic tests cover ownership, source quality, beneficiary matching, claim windows, value, communication, and human-boundary gates.
